killedBy: developer modules stay off ordinary paths (issue #946) the inventory of developer value edges matches the pin exactly
why: One developer module falls off the list the #946 ratchet scans, which is how this guard would go quiet in practice: a module renamed, or a name dropped in a merge, leaving a scan that still reports a tidy number for a smaller set. `dev-config` is one hud.ts imports for value (`canonicalDevSearch`, `devControls`, `DEV_PRESETS`) and that stays listed, so the edge is real and simply stops being counted -- hud.ts reports five where the tree has six. It is the only file whose count moves: `dev-config.ts` imports no listed module, and its other importers (`dev-config-menu`, `dev-diagnostics`, `devtools-menu`) are listed themselves, so they are not counted either way. The pin catches it only because it is an EXACT comparison on a non-zero count; a `<=` ceiling would have passed. `every developer module named in the list still exists` passes, as it must, and that is the point: it asserts that every module STILL LISTED exists and structurally cannot see one that was removed, so the exactness of the pin is what covers this direction. RETARGETED for issue #1012: this entry used to drop `arena-schematic`, which #1012 removed from the list as player-facing code (hud.ts draws the Versus Setup map cards with it on every page). RETARGETED again for issue #1013: it then dropped `controller-selftest`, whose last value edge #1013 removed, so dropping that name left the count equal to the pin and the entry survived. `dev-config` keeps its hud.ts edge until #1015, which loads the Configuration menu on demand; that slice must re-point this entry again.
